issue_context.title: The `01-test_fipsmodule_cnf` test fails because of incorrect argument translation
issue_context.body: In OpenSSL 3.0.0 commit c233e22daa, the perl code in `util/wrap.pl` is being passed a `-` argument. The first line of the script references `/usr/bin/env`, which is causing the `-` argument to be translated to `-i` on the NonStop platform. This translation does not happen on Linux.
